### Observed differences

- **Exits from A01:** in the earlier window, A01's roughly 380 observed outgoing transitions split between A04 (about 50 in 100), A03 (about 29) and A02 (about 22); in the later window, every one of them goes to A04. [DIR001]
- **Exits from A04 and A06:** in the earlier window, about half of A04's outgoing transitions returned directly to A01 (the rest going to A02, about 26 in 100, and A03, about 23), and A06 led to A01 or A04 in roughly equal shares; in the later window, A04 was never observed to return to A01 (it splits between A02, about 47 in 100, and A03, about 53), and A06 always leads to A01. [DIR002, DIR003]
- **Order of A01 and A04:** the two co-occur in every trace in both windows, but earlier they appeared in both orders in similar proportions (A01 first in 25 of 100 traces, A04 first in 28, interleaved or repeated in 47) — no fixed order; in the later window A01 precedes A04 in every trace (strictly before in 58, interleaved or repeated in 42, A04 first never). [REL001]
- **Positions within the trace (event order, not clock time):** in the later window A01 typically occurs as the first event (median relative position 0, mean about 0.29, versus median about 0.45 and mean about 0.40 earlier), and A04 occurs later (mean about 0.50, first quartile about 0.27, versus mean about 0.39 and first quartile 0 earlier). [POS001, POS002]
- **Step distances:** A01→A04 now lies within five steps in all 200 traces, always immediately (earlier: 144 of 200 traces, at one, four or five steps); A04→A01 within five steps falls from 150 to 84 of 200 traces and is now always four steps away (earlier mostly immediate). Self-repeats of A01 and A04 now occur only at five steps (earlier four or five); A01 reaches A02/A03 only at two steps and A04 reaches them only immediately (earlier both at one or two steps). [LAG004, LAG008, LAG001, LAG011, LAG002, LAG003, LAG009, LAG010]
- **A06 relations:** A06→A01 is now always immediate (earlier one or two steps) and A06→A04 occurs at two steps, i.e. via A01 (earlier one or two steps); A01 and A04 now reach A06 at four and three steps (earlier three or four). [LAG013, LAG014, LAG005, LAG012]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the tight back-and-forth cycle between A01 and A04 was replaced, in the later window, by a one-way flow: A06 feeds A01, A01 always leads immediately to A04, and A04 continues to A03 or A02 instead of returning directly to A01, with A01 now opening the trace and A04 placed in its middle. Earlier, A01 and A04 alternated as a repeating pair — each led directly back to the other in about half of its outgoing transitions, both could also exit to A02 or A03, and their order varied from trace to trace; later, A01→A04 is immediate in every trace, the direct A04→A01 return is no longer observed, and A01 is reached again only about four steps after A04, in about 84 of 200 traces versus 150 before. [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, REL001, POS001, POS002, LAG004, LAG008]

This goes beyond sampling variation: 20 of the 27 tested control-flow units qualified, far more than the roughly 0.13 items expected by chance in an unchanged process, and every qualifying difference exceeds about 995 of 1,000 random re-splits of the pooled traces. [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, LAG005, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008, LAG009, LAG010, LAG011, LAG012, LAG013, LAG014, POS001, POS002, REL001]

Limitations: all items are control-flow measures over the same two windows, so the agreeing indicators are facets of one underlying difference rather than independent confirmations; an unobserved edge (such as A04→A01 in the later window) means only that it did not appear in this sample, not that it cannot occur; and the window-level aggregates cannot rule out that the difference is a changed mix of existing trace variants rather than a modification of one dominant flow. [REL001, DIR002, LAG008]

Other differences: the share of traces in which A06 relates to A01 or A04 within five steps fell from about 94 to 84 of 200, while A06's outgoing transitions stayed nearly constant (about 183 versus 180); the evidence cannot tell whether this small drop is more than sampling variation. [LAG013, LAG014, DIR003]
